sentence: A snake draft where the host starts a random pick order, then everyone takes turns choosing snacks from a shared list, with the order reversing each round.
use_when: A group wants to split up a shared list of items by taking turns picking
Choosing who brings which snacks for a game night or party
Running a fair draft where the pick order reverses each round
Picking from a fixed list where each item can only be taken once
dont_use_when: The group just wants to vote on one option or find a favorite (use a poll)
Items need to be assigned by chance with no choice (use a random picker)
Players need to bid or trade for items (use an auction)
